models.name: Brain Tumor CNN
models.dataset_version: legacy Training/Testing (2870 train, 393 test images, 4 classes)

metrics.source: recorded at training time in the legacy notebook; not independently re-verified on this repository's data

calibration.note: Raw softmax probabilities are uncalibrated. The expected calibration error (ECE) can only be measured on a labelled held-out set, which is not present in this repository.

models.description: Original demonstration CNN shipped with the project. Known to overfit (train accuracy 0.98, validation accuracy 0.72). Its label space is exactly 4 classes; tumor types outside {glioma, meningioma, no_tumor, pituitary_tumor} (for example brain metastases) are unrecognized, and out-of-distribution inputs can be misclassified with high nominal probability.
